realTimeIntelligenceAndQuantRadar.synthesis: European mortgage borrowers are navigating the new normal of 4.7% Baufinanzierung rates under ECB's 2.50% deposit stance and 3.42% 10-year Bund yields. With German loans structured as fixed Zinsbindung followed by refinancing (Anschlussfinanzierung), choosing an initial Tilgung of 1% creates an €85,000 interest penalty compared to 2% Tilgung. In the US, Freddie Mac 30-year rates remain elevated at 7.40% alongside 10-year Treasury yields at 5.09%. In the quantitative engineering community, DuckDB-WASM and Parquet continue to displace server-side databases for high-speed client-side financial calculations.
